about: ROUTE R5, THE POLAR TRAIL (One World phase 4.1, the owner's north routes thread, 2026-11-17): a trail from the Mountains' ridge (the Lodge's room; seam ow_v_m13_m22) east and north across the tundra to the North Pole's west wall (seam ow_v_0_m27). 36 plots = TWO rooms by the room-splitting rule (30 plots at most): bake it twice, `--from 0 --to 17` (site_ow_r5_0_17, the ridge to the frozen lake) and `--from 18 --to 35` (site_ow_r5_18_35, on north to the Pole); the two meet on the line y -23. It replaces the Pass Gate doors (`pass`) that jumped from the Lodge to the Pole. PLACES (ow-places.js, every name an idea of Claude's): the page gives a frozen lake and a mountain hut; the rest are the kit's picks by the ground.
